scope: One separately frozen A1–B–A2 direct Vision diagnostic on two procedural images in iOS 27.1 Simulator. The fixed repeat criterion failed. This is neither a production meal-analysis run nor food, training or adoption acceptance.

lineage.scope: F01 has earlier component and direct Vision observations. This batch added one predeclared A1/F01, B/F02, A2/F01 sequence, not one F01 request across the whole investigation. A2 is a planned repeat, not an automatic retry.

protocol.inputRoute: Each case reloads and hashes its fixed PNG, decodes with ImageIO and creates a CIImage with explicit sRGB. Upright orientation, centerCrop and full normalized region of interest are retained.
protocol.renderingContext: A fresh default CIContext is passed through VNImageOption.ciContext for each case. No software-renderer option or CGImage handler substitution.
protocol.computeRoute: Fresh revision-2 requests query request-specific exposed stages, require a returned typed CPU for every stage, select it and verify readback before one perform. No default or alternative-device fallback.
protocol.criteriaMeaning: These heuristic diagnostic bounds were retained unchanged and frozen before this batch; they are not Apple guarantees, calibrated confidence or semantic thresholds.

actual.cleanupTerminateMeaning: The command reported nothing to terminate; it did not establish OS compute release.

independentReview.method: Filesystem hashes, frozen and built/installed inventories, approval/controller identity, saved cleanup records and retained-container copies; independent Float32 decoding and all 2,304 JSON-to-Float32 byte roundtrips. No controller import, API, rerun or Simulator action by the reviewer.
independentReview.meaning: Consistent evidence and failed numerical criterion, not a numerical or recognition pass.

interpretation: All three configured requests returned one finite, nonconstant 768-value vector. The A1-versus-B differences exceeded the frozen heuristic floors, but the identical F01 repeat exceeded both fixed repeat ceilings and stopped the batch.

B and A2 have exactly the same 3,072 observation bytes despite their different frozen PNG inputs. A1 differs from both and matches the earlier single F01 observation. These are recorded identities; they do not establish useful input sensitivity, semantic separation or a general reproducibility property.

Static review found no concrete mistake in the fixed case/input mapping, per-case reload or separate binary names. Source-input hash checks do not establish which rendered pixels Vision consumed. The cause of the observed B/A2 equality and repeat difference remains unknown.

App-report exit 6 records the failed repeat criterion. Console and controller exits zero mean the bounded launch was observed and its diagnostic failure was retained and classified; they do not override that failure.
The bootstatus command exited zero while logging Data Migration Failed. That warning remains; recorded shutdown and copied evidence do not establish environment health or OS compute release.

No threshold was relaxed, no request was retried and no head was trained or adopted. This does not establish a causal CPU or Espresso explanation, component MLShapedArray equivalence, food/name accuracy, calibrated abstention, physical-device, network-isolated offline, UI, performance, nutrition, clinical or submission readiness.

nextInvestigation.status: Follow-up recorded separately in ci-input-witness-20261025.json: compiled, but the one launch attempt returned no process handle and retained no app outputs. Render checkpoints remain unobserved.
nextInvestigation.proposal: Resolve the separate witness startup failure before interpreting decoded/rendered input pixels or making further feature requests. Preserve this failed repeat and its original numerical bounds. A render-only witness cannot by itself prove which pixels the prior Vision requests consumed.
nextInvestigation.notApproved: No tolerance relaxation, retry of this batch, food classifier training, gate adoption or production processing change.

privacy: No fixture pixels, scalar arrays, observation binaries, raw errors or memory addresses, private absolute paths, account/device identifiers or model weights are copied into the repository. Local artifacts remain outside it.
